Visitor replaces heading with custom format

```elixir title="Elixir"
visitor = %{
      :handle_heading => fn(args) ->
        {:custom, "--- " <> Map.get(args, "text", "") <> " ---"}
      end,
    }

result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<h2>Section Title</h2><p>Content below heading.</p>", %{visitor: visitor})
IO.inspect(result)
```
